name: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD — wiiking2.sav

magic.description: Seen in one dump so far; a different header still opens after a prompt.

slot.label: File {n}
slot.description: Same struct as the Wii slots, little-endian. The 4th slot looked like a later copy of file 3 in the one sample (possibly an autosave).

slotExtra.label: File {n} extra data
slotExtra.description: Per-slot HD-only data, covered by that slot's checksum. Contents not yet understood.

slotExtra2.label: File {n} extra data 2
slotExtra2.description: Second per-slot HD-only block, also covered by that slot's checksum.

skip.label: Skip data
skip.description: Starts with the same bytes as skip.dat.

checksums.description: Standard CRC32 run over the slot's 0x53BC bytes, then its two extra blocks, stored little-endian at the end of the slot. Found in the game's FileManager code (main ~0xDFAE30 in v1.0.0, ~0xDFA7E4 in v1.0.1; same ranges in both).
